errors.text: The proposed ZrHf-rich segregation mechanism is chemically inapplicable to CoCrFeNiTi, which contains neither Zr nor Hf.
The claimed HCP nucleation thresholds near 1000–1100 °C and critical heating or cooling rates are not established by the cited evidence for this alloy.

The falsification rule is logically inconsistent: observing more HCP after the deliberately slow, high-temperature treatment would support the proposed processing-window boundary rather than falsify it.

Load- and dwell-dependent indentation alone cannot reliably separate Hall–Petch strengthening from solute strengthening without composition-matched samples having independently varied and measured grain sizes.
